assertions.meaning: Reject malformed image dimensions, data or unsupported-mask/count consistency.
Requires equal unsupported counts AND exact mask Data equality; mean RGB-channel error <=1 and fraction of channels with error >4 <=0.005.
Every invalid pixel position must match; no zero-unsupported requirement.

coordinates.meaning: Subtract subject center from camera/sample/area positions in SIMD3<Double> before pack converts components to Float. Absolute translated world coordinates are not the <=20-meter support rule.
